title: Spec: kbs now JIT fail-closed and purge
description:
Authoritative Gherkin spec for production `kbs now` just-in-time real summaries.

Requirements:
- JIT real summaries only; never placeholder or mock strings
- Fail closed when the LLM pipeline cannot produce a valid summary
- Purge command clears only `right_now_summary` and `right_now_updated_at` across the board, including `virtual_projects`
- SD acceptance scenarios run against `/workspace/projects-meta`

Deliverable: behavior specs in `features/` that both Python and Rust implementations must satisfy before merge.
